rubric_content.text_property: Each simulated shopper follows a realistic shopping path through aisles consistent with their persona preferences and demographics
Shoppers stay within their stated budget. If a shopper exceeds budget, there is a clear reason related to impulse tendency or endcap interaction
Endcap interactions are explicitly reported for each shopper including whether they picked up the item and why or why not
Aggregate metrics are calculated correctly: total revenue, endcap conversion rate, average basket size, and per-persona breakdown
Recommendations for merchandising optimization are specific, actionable, and grounded in the simulation data
